newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Scuderi and Nielsen boost South Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Scuderi and Nielsen boost South Australia.

text.p: South Australia have built a commanding first innings total in the Sheffield Shield match against Tasmania after Joe Scuderi and Tim Nielsen posted a century partnership for the sixth wicket.
After resuming on 251 for five, South Australia moved to 336 for six at lunch on the second day at Bellerive Oval.
Scuderi, who remained unbeaten on 65 at the interval, and Nielsen put the visitors on top by adding 122 runs in better than even time.
Openers Ben Johnson and Martin Faull laid the platform for the innings with a century first-wicket partnership on Tuesday.
Tasmania's failure to break through frustrated captain David Boon in his pursuit of a victory that would lift his side into second place on the Shield table behind leaders Western Australia.
